description: AUDIO GEM - E-commerce web application for audio equipment

features.name: Home Hero Section
features.description: Hero section with animated visual cards and bargain banner

features.name: Featured Products
features.description: Display featured products as interactive cards
userInteractions: View product cards with image, name, price
Click 'Agregar al carrito' button on product card
Click 'Ver producto' button on product card

features.name: Categories Section
userInteractions: Click category cards to navigate to products filtered by category

features.name: Products Catalog
features.description: Full product catalog with filtering and product cards
userInteractions: View product cards with image, name, price, badges
Click 'Agregar al carrito' button on product card
Click 'Ver producto' button on product card

features.name: About Page
features.description: About us page with hero and values

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Contact form with validation and WhatsApp integration
userInteractions: See validation errors on invalid input
See success message on successful submission
Click WhatsApp button to open WhatsApp chat

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Side drawer cart with add/remove/update items
userInteractions: Click cart icon to open drawer
View cart items with quantity controls

features.name: Floating WhatsApp Button
userInteractions: Click floating button to open WhatsApp chat

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Navbar with navigation links and cart access
userInteractions: Click navigation links (Home, Productos, Nosotros, Contacto)
Click cart icon to open cart drawer

routes.description: Home page with hero, featured products, categories, brands, testimonials, gallery
Products catalog with category filter and product cards
About page with hero and values section
Contact page with contact form and contact info

knownLimitations.issue: No backend API - all data is static/mock from JS files
knownLimitations.impact: Product data, testimonials, brands are not fetched from API

knownLimitations.issue: Contact form submits to WhatsApp only, no email/backend integration
knownLimitations.impact: Form data not persisted in database

knownLimitations.issue: Cart state is only in memory (React Context), not persisted
